text:
tess: Quick idea  casual weekday happy hour + "emoji trivia" in the lounge next Wed 6:30-8pm? small rounds, prizes (stickers), low pressure. :cocktail::smile:

omar: Love it. need both mocktails and beers pls. i'm in. :beers::sparkles:

kevin: count me in if trivia is very silly. i will absolutely lose on emoji-only clues. :joy:

mia: i'm in. bringing a box of gluten-free snacks. :cookie:

ravi: can we do one round of company-themed questions? like product history + silly facts. fun and inclusive.

gina: yes on company-themed! also can we keep it short 20-25 min rounds so people can mingle.

tess: planning 4 rounds: warmup icebreaker, company-themed, pop-culture emoji mashup, and lightning speed. Prizes: sticker packs + a $10 coffee card. react :one: if you approve prizes.

kevin: :one: approved

omar: :one:

ops-bot: Reminder: For team-socials purchases submit `/expense submit --amount <total> --category team-socials --notes "emoji trivia happy hour"`

facilities: Lounge is available Wed 18:00-20:30. We can set up two cocktail tables and provide a small bar cart. If you'd like glassware instead of disposables, request 48h ahead.

mia: request glassware pls. less trash. also can we add a non-alcoholic station?

tess: yes to glassware and mocktail station. adding to event notes. @events-bot can you reserve lounge and add a note for glassware + mic?

events-bot: Reserve request received. Use `/event reserve --space lounge --start 18:30 --end 20:00 --notes "emoji trivia + happy hour; glassware; mic"` to finalize.

ravi: small accessibility ask: can we put a high-contrast emoji key on the slides for anyone who uses screen magnifiers?

tess: great point. will prep a large-font slide and post a text transcript in the chat during rounds.

gina: volunteers for setup/cleanup? i can do 15 min after.

omar: i can help with setup and bring a portable speaker.

kevin: i'll make the trivia slides. any favorite categories?

mia: food allergies note: peanut-free please. i'll flag on sign-up sheet.

tess: adding a short RSVP + dietary form: https://tiny.redwood/emoji-trivia-rsvp  drop name, plus-one, dietary notes, and whether you want to volunteer. closing signups Tue 3pm.

kevin: tiny rule suggestion: teams max of 4 to keep rounds fair.

ravi: agree. team size 2-4. also suggest a "mystery bonus point" where random emoji gives a double score. keeps it fun.

gina: love the mystery bonus idea.

ops-bot: Budget reminder: small events under $150 can be auto-approved. For amounts >$150 submit an approval request to finance.

facilities: Note: if you want the projector, please confirm by Tue noon.

tess: yes projector please. also a lav mic for host. kevin can host slides.

kevin: happy to host slides. anyone want to co-host as emcee?

omar: i'll emcee a round or two and keep vibes hype. :raised_hands:

mia: RSVP +1 (bringing partner). added to the sheet.

ravi: RSVP.

gina: RSVP.

kevin: last note: i'll craft 24 emoji-only clues and a backup set. will post a sample round here tomorrow for feedback.

tess: perfect. final checklist: reserve lounge with events-bot, RSVP sheet, glassware + mic request, volunteers for setup, budget <150 likely. See you Wed! :tada:
